alt: A made-up cross section of two papyrus wraps: an orange published label beside the first wrap moves along its normals onto the wrap's recto face and turns blue; then a dashed truth face and its one-voxel band appear.
caption: Concept illustration: a published label (orange) snapped along its normals onto the recto face (blue), then a truth face (dashed) with its band of one voxel on each side. Made-up data, no scan and no model output.
